title: The End's Recalling
description: What if you can build using blocks from the end dimension without ever going to the end dimension in the first place?
body:
# Description:
This is a datapack that was made for a private server i was in.

and was made for player in early game or in any stage that hasn't reached the end dimension to get meterials from the end for building.
